headline: Major Corporates Object to Tokenized Shares on Innovation Venue
summary: Companies including Microsoft and McDonald's opposed being listed on the first tokenized securities venue operating under the SEC's innovation exemption, reflecting corporate caution toward on-chain equities.
why: Securities tokenization is viewed as a key bridge between conventional capital markets and blockchain-based secondary trading systems.

impacts.name: Tokenized Securities
impacts.why: Pushback from blue-chip equity issuers slows institutional liquidity adoption on emerging digital trading platforms.
